email.subject: teach me??
email.body:
ok so I found an old computer in a cupboard and it WORKS. I'm logged in. teach me? send me commands and I'll type exactly what you send (write dex ...). my club flyer is in here somewhere. notes.txt knows which one.

Dex

how.txt: sends one line to dex's terminal.
he types it exactly. typos too.

notes.txt: things to fix: bike, sleep, grades
flyer 4 is just the word FLYER

replies.right: IT OPENED. I did that. ok you did. WE did. new club flyer says: we fix things by hand.
